name: Random String Generator
description: Generate cryptographically secure random strings of any length, from letters, digits, symbols, or your own custom character set.

faq.question: How is this different from the Password Generator?
faq.answer: This is general-purpose: any length, any character pool (including your own custom characters), with no strength meter or guaranteed per-category coverage. The Password Generator is purpose-built for passwords — it guarantees at least one character from each selected category and reports an entropy/strength estimate, which isn't always what you want for, say, generating random test IDs or codes.

faq.question: Is the randomness actually secure?
faq.answer: Yes — every character is drawn using the Web Crypto API's crypto.getRandomValues() with rejection sampling to avoid modulo bias, the same secure-randomness approach used throughout this site, never the predictable Math.random().
